name: Camping Wohnmobilstellplatz Plankenhof
beschreibung: The Camping Wohnmobilstellplatz Plankenhof is situated in Pill, a village in the Tyrolean lowlands. Run by a local farm, the site provides peaceful pitches for motorhomes and tents. The hillside setting offers quiet surroundings and scenic views across the Inntal valley. Modern sanitary facilities and electric hookups are provided. Hiking paths start right at the property, making the Plankenhof an ideal stopover for travellers or a peaceful retreat in nature.
